name: restaurant-ops-platform
description: Restaurant Operations & Ordering Platform — full-stack Agile/Scrum project (all 10 sprints)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:lockfiles && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm --dir server run lint && pnpm --dir server test && pnpm --dir frontend run lint && pnpm --dir frontend run test && pnpm --dir frontend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm run audit:prod
